webBundlePaths.margin: floor(measured lane-base gzip bytes * 1.005), a 0.5% allowance per path; the baseline is pinned, not a moving main reference
webBundlePaths.metric: Sum node:zlib.gzipSync defaults per unique JavaScript asset in the union of the named Vite manifest roots' static-import closures. CSS and optional dynamic children are excluded.
webBundlePaths.roots: initial: index.html; Editor shell: initial + Workbench; Agent + one chat: Editor shell + AgentWorkbenchBody + ChatSurface + AcpChatPresentation; Editor Diff/Search: Editor shell + the respective Surface; Editor File: Editor shell + FileSurface + CodeMirrorEditorRuntime (language parsers remain optional). Folded roots use named chunk ownership pinned by vite.config.test.ts.

initialHeadroom.margin: floor(97113 * 1.005) = 97598 B: 485 B of margin, following the existing 0.5% path convention. Both initial-closure caps use this ceiling.
initialHeadroom.reason: Harness discovery imports only harness validation and shared command guards. Transcript, permission and preview adapters remain behind the existing Chat and Preview lazy surfaces. No new dynamic imports or dependencies.

webBundlePaths.desktopOptimization: Desktop builds derive React/JSX named exports from the installed runtime and verify the resolved production/development export surface, eliminating repeated CommonJS property-call indirection without a fixed export allowlist. Missing or undefined virtual exports fail the build, and ESLint bans React namespace imports. jsx/jsxs share a binding only when the resolved production runtime exports the identical function. Development/browser builds keep normal resolution. AcpChatPresentation and shared chat helpers coalesce with eager tool presentation, excluding saved-diff/Mermaid renderers; saved diffs remain explicit-click lazy. CodeMirrorEditorRuntime coalesces with the base it always loads before any language facade. No language parser or Lezer LR engine enters the plain File closure.

markdownDependency.impact: About 41 KB gzip, demand-loaded with the first markdown render; about 0.3 ms per typical answer and about 0.2 MB retained for one shared parser. No HTML, linkify or typographer. No plugin packages.
markdownDependency.lifetime: Only rules persist in the shared parser. Tokens and environments are released after each parse. Per-view bounded source, document and suffix offsets are collected on unmount; no per-message parser or global transcript cache.
markdownDependency.budget: markdown-rendering: original 45169 B cap plus the ordered-container measured delta of 878 B = 46047 B cap. Identical desktop-native Vite builds with locked dependencies measure 44348 B gzip at 8e57ef5f and 45226 B with ordered list/quote children, shared text traversal and descendant limits. The cap increases only by that measured delta, preserving existing headroom. All other caps remain unchanged.
